text: I think I take things less personally. My manager is quite moody and I used to be anxious every time she was in a bad mood, thinking it was my fault. Now I see it's her stuff and I just get on with my work.

Ich bin in belastenden Situationen geduldiger mit mir. Ich muss nicht mehr sofort eine Lösung haben, sondern kann mir Zeit lassen. Das hat mir beim Umzug und beim Jobwechsel letztes Jahr sehr geholfen.
Not much

I had been dealing with a lot of stress around my immigration status. I've lived in this country for 12 years, but my visa situation has always been uncertain, and every renewal was a nightmare that kept me up for weeks. During the experience I had a sense that my home is not a place or a piece of paper, but something inside me. That has helped me a lot. The last renewal was stressful, but I didn't lose sleep over it. I did what I needed to do and trusted that I would be okay, wherever I ended up. I also talked to other people in the same situation, which made me feel less alone.

Ich habe in der Erfahrung gesehen, dass ich mich bei Stress immer selbst bestrafe, indem ich zu wenig esse und zu wenig schlafe. Ich achte jetzt bewusster darauf, mich in solchen Phasen gut zu versorgen.

The experience made me see that a lot of my stress came from trying to live up to an image of myself that wasn't real. I was trying to be the successful one, the strong one, the one who has it all together. During the experience all of that fell away and I saw myself as just a human being, vulnerable and imperfect, and it was such a relief. Since then, stressful events don't threaten my identity in the same way. If I fail at something, it doesn't mean I'm a failure. I can just be a person who failed at something. This has made me much more resilient. I've also become more honest with my friends about my struggles, and it turns out they have them too.
Stay calm better
Durch die Erfahrung habe ich gelernt, Stress als etwas Vorübergehendes zu sehen. Ich weiß jetzt, dass jede schwierige Phase auch wieder vorbeigeht. Das gibt mir Ruhe.

I've learned to recognise when my body is stressed before my mind catches up. I get tension in my jaw and my shoulders, and my stomach hurts. I didn't connect those things before. Now when I notice them I do some stretching, go for a walk or just breathe for a few minutes, and it helps.
I'm better at coping with the stress of being a student and working at the same time. I accept that I can't do everything perfectly.

Ich bin seit der Erfahrung gelassener, wenn es Konflikte gibt, und kann meine Meinung ruhiger vertreten. Früher habe ich entweder geschwiegen oder bin laut geworden. Jetzt finde ich öfter einen Mittelweg.
I don't think it has changed how I handle stress. The experience was beautiful, but it was more about connection with nature and didn't really touch the way I deal with problems.

Since the experience I am much more aware of my thought patterns. I had been in a really toxic cycle of anxiety and avoidance. When something stressful came up, I'd worry about it for days, then avoid dealing with it, then feel guilty and worry more. During the experience I saw this whole loop very clearly and I saw how it was keeping me stuck. Breaking it hasn't been easy, but I'm much better at it now. I deal with things sooner, I write lists, I break tasks down into small steps. When I notice the worry starting, I ask myself what one small thing I can do right now. It has made a big difference.
Ich habe weniger Angst vor Veränderungen. Belastende Ereignisse, die mit Veränderung zu tun haben, wie ein neuer Job oder ein Umzug, machen mir nicht mehr so viel aus.
I'm more aware of how my stress affects other people, especially my family. I try not to take it out on them.

I'm better at handling the stress of parenting. My kids are 3 and 5 and it's chaos. I used to lose my temper a lot. Now I can usually take a breath and respond calmly. I also accept that some days will just be hard, and that's ok.
Ich bin durch die Erfahrung eher sensibler geworden und nehme Stress stärker wahr. Das ist nicht unbedingt schlecht, weil ich früher alles ignoriert habe, aber es macht manches auch schwerer.

I think I've become more resilient because I've learned to trust the process of life. Things have a way of working out, even when they seem terrible at first. I've seen this happen many times since the experience.

The experience has helped me cope with my ex-husband, who is very difficult. We share custody of our kids, so I have to deal with him a lot, and every interaction used to leave me shaking. During the experience I saw him as a wounded child, and I felt compassion for him, which I never thought possible. It doesn't mean I accept his behaviour, I still set firm boundaries, but I don't get as triggered. I can stay calm in our exchanges and focus on what's best for the kids. I also stopped needing him to acknowledge that he was wrong, which was a big source of stress for me.
Ich mache mir weniger Sorgen und schlafe auch in stressigen Zeiten besser.
I think I'm more emotionally intelligent now, and that helps with stressful situations at work and in relationships. I understand what people are feeling and I can respond better.
I am a lot less stressed in general. I don't overthink everything anymore

Mir ist durch die Erfahrung klar geworden, dass ich meinen Selbstwert stark über meine Arbeit definiere, und dass jeder Fehler im Job für mich eine Bedrohung meines ganzen Selbst ist. Seitdem versuche ich, mehr Abstand zu meiner Arbeit zu gewinnen. Ich habe mir ein Hobby gesucht, das nichts mit Leistung zu tun hat, nämlich Töpfern, und ich treffe mich mehr mit Freunden. Wenn bei der Arbeit etwas schiefgeht, kann ich das jetzt besser einordnen. Es ist ärgerlich, aber es sagt nichts darüber aus, wer ich bin.
I'm more okay with things not being perfect. That's reduced my stress a lot.
No change, honestly. I was hoping for more but nothing really shifted in that area.

Die Erfahrung hat mir geholfen, belastende Erlebnisse aus der Vergangenheit zu verarbeiten, und dadurch reagiere ich auch auf neue Belastungen weniger heftig. Früher hat jede Kleinigkeit alte Wunden aufgerissen, vor allem wenn mich jemand kritisiert hat. Heute bin ich da viel stabiler.
I'm less reactive. I take time to think before responding to stressful emails or messages, and I don't send angry replies anymore.

The experience was in a ceremony with my partner, and it brought us much closer. When stressful things happen now, we face them together. We had a really hard year with my partner's health and money problems, and I think we got through it because we feel like a team. Before, we would have turned against each other.
Ich bin nicht mehr so schnell überfordert, weil ich gelernt habe, Prioritäten zu setzen und mich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren.
I look at stressful events with more curiosity now. Instead of panicking, I ask what I can learn from this. I know that sounds like a self-help book, but it really is how I feel since the experience.
It made me more anxious and paranoid in stressful situations. I'm working on it.

Ich habe gelernt, dass ich in schwierigen Zeiten nicht alles allein schaffen muss. Ich habe angefangen, mit Freunden über meine Probleme zu sprechen, und das hilft mir sehr. Früher habe ich immer so getan, als wäre alles in Ordnung.

I've accepted that I have limited control over most things, and that has freed up a lot of energy. I focus on what I can do and let go of the rest. When my company announced layoffs, I updated my CV and then stopped worrying about it. I kept my job in the end, but I would have been fine either way.
I'm a lot more aware of my triggers and I can avoid them or prepare for them.

Ich habe das Gefühl, dass ich heute eine innere Ruhe habe, die mir in stressigen Situationen hilft. Diese Ruhe habe ich in der Erfahrung zum ersten Mal gespürt, und seitdem kann ich sie manchmal wiederfinden, wenn ich mich hinsetze, die Augen schließe und atme. Das klappt nicht immer, aber oft genug, um einen Unterschied zu machen.
It's helped me cope with the stress of my divorce. I see it as a chance for a new beginning rather than a failure.
Better at coping with change and uncertainty. My life has been very unstable for the last few years and I think I've handled it surprisingly well.
Kaum, vielleicht etwas entspannter
I'm less afraid of my own emotions, so stressful events don't feel as overwhelming. I know I can feel sad or angry or scared and still be okay.

I handle stress better because I have a stronger sense of who I am and what matters to me. During the experience I got very clear about my values, family, honesty, creativity. When I'm stressed now, I ask myself what matters most in this situation, and that helps me decide what to do. It cuts through a lot of the noise and worry.
